avis.titre: Highly Recommended as a Hyaluronic Acid Serum

My nose was getting dried and no other stuff was doing much to heal, but this one looks like it has done well with dryness.
Absolutely love this! I have DRY, SENSITIVE, IRRITATED skin, and this did everything for me! Will be buying again.

I use this during the night because I use treinoin & this has saved my skin. My coworkers and family have noticed the glow on my skin. I'm obsessed. This Healing Ointment does what its name professes: it heals. I use it every night on my hands and feet. It helps ny skin and nails . I have very sore feet and this ointment soothes them so I can sleep without pain. Wen I remember, I also apply it during the day.

I live in the dry desert, have sensitive skin and eczema. I started using a retinoid to help my pores and it gave me the most painful flare up I've ever had, cracking and peeling my skin all over my face to the point of tears and embarrased to go to work. This product instantly helped and has allowed me to complete my skincare routine! I feel great and my skin is glowing. So happy to find this!

I use this daily on my lips. I love that it absorbs quickly and it doesnt have any taste. A little goes a long way so its a great value item. Sometimes if i get a dry patch on my hands from work, ill cover it with some of this ointment and it clears right up.

I was really impressed with how quickly this product absorbed into my skin no greasy or heavy feeling at all. It felt completely weightless and left my skin super soft right away. After just a few uses, I noticed a big difference in my cracked skin it's hydrated, and looks so much healthier. Definitely exceeded my expectations!

This serum (though it feels more like a really, really lightweight cream), has single-handedly brought my skin back the depths of skincare overkill. I got overambitious with some products that my skin didn't agree with and I had to bring it back to the basics. This product has dramatically changed my skin's barrier within a matter of days. Honestly, I wasn't thrilled to buy it because let's be real, there's better packaging and cooler brands out there, but this will probably become one of my holy grails for barrier repair. She will be a recurring purchase for sure!

Makes a definite (although temporary...you'll have to reapply for evening) difference in the appearance of vertical lines around my lips. It makes less off a difference in eye wrinkles and none at all in my forehead or neck.

I initially got this for dry skin because I live in the desert now. I started using it on my dry hands at night before bed, which worked alright. I started using it on my dry lips, and THAT has been great! I recently started using a lotion on my face and then sealing it with this before bed to go to sleep. That has changed my skin texture entirely! I now do this method on my hands as well, where I use the hydrating lotion and then seal it with this! Absolute game changer! Using it by itself works, but using it as a sealer for something else is incredible!
First time using this product. Extremely pleased. I saw healing within 2 days. No smell very reasonably priced. Would recommend and will purchase again.
I use this twice a day after washing my face, and it really moisturizes it. I wear it under moisturizer and sunscreen. Great little product, and it lasts a long time.

Disclaimer: please follow your derm/esthetician/tattoo artists post care instructions, everyone and every treatment is different. I recently got my face lasered (erbium yag) and this stuff helped accelerate the healing process and provided much needed relief fast. I've always been iffy about putting straight Vaseline on my face, so this has been an excellent alternative. It sinks into the skin faster than Vaseline, while keeping the surface hydrated/moist. I can't recommend this enough for major treatments such as IPL, Erbium Yag Laser or tattoo healing.
I just got my serum in the mail yesterday. Nothing comes out of the pump and it feels like it might be empty.
So good for my skin, especially in the winter. I don't know if I could go without this.
Started trentinoin treatments from my dermatologist and it helped so much with dry flaky skin. Product stayed on skin through gym session and helped overnight dryness.
I got the mini size if this and i put it on spots that crease and peel off before i do my makeup and makeup is flawless
I got the mini size if this and i put it on spots that crease and peel off before i do my makeup and makeup is flawless

This serum goes on like silk and dries quickly! I will buy this again!
This is better than vaseline because if the ceramides, in my opinion. This never makes me break out, and works so well at night. Either over my mositurizer or heavy for slugging.
I use this on my lips everyday. I also use it on dry patches on my body and I've used it on burns. Great to have in my home. I will always repurchase.

On my acne prone face it wasn't the best, I was about to throw it out until I used it as a lip balm/lip mask over night. When I tell you that it healed and hydrated my lip so well its was unbelievable. No need to buy more lip balm because this product tops them all.
used it for my skin burnt body. took a couple days but I stopped shedding. it's just very hard to get product out of the tube

literally Like Vaseline! Love this for my skin and as well for my toddlers. literally a multi-task product. I have sensitive skin/dry (rosacea) Love to use it only at night time mostly. little goes a long way!

Please never discontinue this product. Sincerely, A Cerave lover.

This ointment has all but fixed my dry skin. I live in a dry state that can leave your skin feeling like a cement sidewalk. I use this every single night and no longer have any dry patches, flaking, redness, NOTHING! It has been a game changer

avis.titre: I WILL USE THIS UNTILL THE DAY I DIE

This product is amazing, I noticed a huge difference in my skin after about two weeks of using CeraVe products. I'm 43 years old with combination acne prone skin. If you work in healthcare/food prep anything where you constantly wash your hands - this is a no brainer! My hands feel so much relief! I keep it at home, work, and in my purse.

It's really good for skin barrier repair. Packaging is convenient. Has thick texture and no scents. Ingredient includes petroleum and other healing stuff. I use it for slugging in winter and it works great.

I am loving this product so much! I've been using it for a month now and it's made a huge difference on my skin. My skin is sensitive and tends to dry and this has moisturized my skin and helped with breakouts! I love it

Best ointment ever! Great replacement for Vaseline! The consistency is amazing and it leaves my dry skin feeling great! Amazing for the cost too

Amazing! Non-greasy and very hydrating and nourishing on my skin! Definitely a staple for everyday dryness for my skin!!

In the video provided is my skin recently. I recommend this product for anyone looking to make a difference within their skin routine.

I was lucky to receive the advanced repair ointment from the cerave community (uk) in exchange for an honest review, this ointment is brilliant for dry areas knees and elbows, this has become my home essential product its also very good for dry skin spots and on the lips , such a good product ,skin feels smoothe too I would recommend

I have been using this on my face, arms, legs and hands. It is amazing. I'm a daily swimmer and in the Florida sun. My husband also uses it in his face. He just finished treatment on his face for pre cancer and this is healing it FAST.
Love this! Use it on dry skin, lips, hands, face, and find it more moisturizing than aquaphor, less greasy than vaseline.

i suffer from really dry, chapped lips especially in the winter and i've tried endless different products to try and help but nothing worked. until i found this. this keeps them hydrated for the whole day, can't recommend enough!

This is the best ointment I have ever used. I have extra dry skin and my Doctor recommended this for my skin.

avis.titre: A product that works & is affordable

If you get the knock off brand you can get it for dirt cheap, it does the exact same thing and there's no added ingredients that might give you a reaction. This stuff's not bad at all, but why pay more when you can get it for way less.

Obsessed. I keep tubes of this in my car, on my nightstand, my son's diaper bag, everywhere. It's my lip moisturizer (bc chapstick is the devil) and my lips are always moisturized! I slug with this on my face, hands, and feet as well.

I really like this product. I will put it on my feet before bed to keep them moisturized or use it on my face and lips to "slug". It's very effective in winter months when my skin gets really dry

My new go-to for slugging. Will never use plain old aquaphor again now that I've got my hands on Cerave Healing Ointment. Lightweight and not oily at all which is just what Ive been looking for. Will definitely recommend to anyone with sensitive acne prone skin!

If you're after effective, dermatologist-backed skincare, this ointment is a game-changer!

This product absorbs quickly. Just with my skin needs during the dry winter months.
This gentle moisturizer traps in moisture and leaves your skin feeling renewed and rejuvenated! Not heavy but does exactly what it does and repairs the skin within the first use!

It helps create a thick smooth barrier on my skin when I have an eczema breakout. I've had mine for months. You get a good amount of product in the container.

A little goes a long way, and I keep the smaller 1.8 oz bottles at work, in my bag, and at my bed side table. There is no smell (who needs fragrance in product anyways?) whatsoever, perfect for sensitive skin.

Winter months are always a struggle with dry cracked skin. I purchased this product in hopes it would help my husbands hands. It has! After one use he can already tell a difference. I wish I would have known about this product years ago.

Then I learned from a dermatologist that castor seed oil (ricinus communis), which is in almost every lip care & lip color product, can be a highly reactive ingredient for sensitive skin. He recommended CeraVe healing ointment, and within 48 hours the unsightly peeling completely stopped. I threw away all products containing castor seed oil and I always have CeraVe healing ointment with me. It comes in small .35oz tubes as well. It's great for cuticles too.

Wish I could get a refund because I've only used it a week. I did give it 2 stars because it does leave my skin feeling nice and hydrated, if it layered better this would be a no brainer.
You get your bang for your buck here. Always looking for a cost effective serum for my routine. This fits the bill and totally works!

This is thick, reminds me of Vaseline. A little bit goes a long way. Great for owies on little ones with dry sore skin, great for anybody with dry skin. The big container has lasted me for months.there is no scent to it.
very very good product soothing to the skin but it does unfortunately have a weird scent to it but fine a few minutes after applying it helps the skin well works like vaseline

avis.titre: This Ointment Is A Good Daily Moisturizer For Dry Skin
avis.texte: This CeraVe Healing Ointment helps to heal my itchy skin. I live i Colorado where weather and conditions are extremely dry. I apply it daily or as needed. I always make sure I have it on hand. I usually put it on after a shower and it really sinks into my skin throughout the day for a noticeable difference.

Texture? Check! It's just like any ointment or Vaseline, but without the funny smells. And let me tell you, it's got this white-ish clear color that'll make your skin shine like a disco ball. Who needs highlighter when you've got CeraVe Healing Ointment? Now, full disclosure, my package arrived with a little label damage. But hey, who cares about a few peeling and torn labels when everything else is working like a charm? It's like finding a scratch on a shiny new car – it's the inside that counts, my friend! But wait, there's more! This marvelous balm isn't just for show. It's here to rescue your dry or cracked skin, whether it's on your cuticles, knuckles, elbows, heels, or even your luscious lips.
